descriptionHtml:
MSI Cyborg 15 A13UC-2079XEG Gaming Laptop - Intel Core i5-13420H - RTX 3050 4GB - Cyberpunk Translucent Edition

Embrace the ultimate cyberpunk aesthetic and futuristic gaming power with the budget-friendly MSI Cyborg 15 A13UC-2079XEG, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a groundbreaking translucent chassis design, this laptop lets you see its internal mechanics while delivering balanced performance. Driven by the architectural efficiency of the Intel Core i5-13420H processor and accelerated by the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 dedicated graphics engine, it ensures great frame rates across popular competitive titles. Enjoy crisp and smooth gameplay on the 15.6-inch FHD display with a fast 144Hz refresh rate. Equipped with an illuminated blue gaming keyboard and a specialized cooling layout, this sleek and lightweight powerhouse is backed by a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
